title: THE STYLING PASS, STAGE E: THE STASH AND THE SHOP
why: His order of 2026-10-03: styling across all menus needs massive improvement. Stage E is the stash and the shop: item and shop cells as rounded tiles with a light from the top and a small lift on hover, rounded tabs, a rounded shop grid and a shadowed detail card. Rarity colours, sizes and every word are unchanged.
now: The stash and shop cells and tabs have the new rounded, shaded look.
